title: Bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Sanhedrin 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.27a.21) relates that he killed a person. The Exilarch told Rav Abba bar Yaakov, “Go and investigate the matter; if he certainly killed, put out his eyes.” Rav Pappi found grounds in his favor. Bar Chama rose and kissed Rav Pappi’s feet and undertook to pay his taxes for the rest of his life.[^1]

notes.text: [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sanhedrin.27a.21.1) explains the eye punishment literally and also records interpretations involving payment to the heirs or excommunication. [The continuation](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.27b.7-9) describes Bar Chama kissing Rav Pappi’s feet and undertaking to pay his tax, לכרגיה. The supplied Hebrew reads לכרניה.
